newsitem.title: JAPAN: Debenture buying not aimed at supporting banks - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Debenture buying not aimed at supporting banks - MOF.

text.p: The Japanese Finance Ministry's purchases of bank debentures are not aimed at supporting certain financial institutions, a senior ministry official told a parliamentary committee on Friday.

The official said the ministry has a right under the law to invest in instruments such as government bonds and bank debentures, but he added: "It (the buying) is not aimed at supporting a certain financial institution."

Asked whether the Ministry of Finance's Trust Fund Bureau, whose policy is to invest in safe and secure instruments, would continue to buy bank debentures, the official said: "The bureau would like to manage its funds appropriately in line with the policy outlined in the law."
